hardware: mid-tier reference: Intel i5-12xxx / 16 GB DDR4 / integrated GPU
scenario: Load /dashboard → History tab first paint, 25 rows, no filters
notes: Render cost dominated by RowDetail JSON pre-compute (memoized at the row level; not in the hot path until the row is expanded).
Filter changes reset page to 1 and issue a single fetch. No cascade re-render because row components are keyed by scan.id and the table header is a stable subtree.
Virtualization deferred — page_size caps at 100; even at that size the row count is well under the 150 ms budget.
SEV_PILL and STATUS_ACCENT maps are module-level constants; no per-row re-computation.
